name: Guilford Art Center Summer Art for Kids + Teens
description_short: Weekly half-day art classes for kids ages 5-12 and teens 13+, held 9am-12pm and 1-4pm. You can combine a morning and an afternoon class with paid bridge care at midday to make a full day. Classes include ceramics, wheel pottery, sewing, metalsmithing, stained glass, blacksmithing, comics, drawing, painting and mixed media.
refund_policy_summary: If GAC cancels a class, you get full tuition back or a credit toward another course. If you withdraw at least 2 weeks before the class starts, you get a full refund. If you withdraw up to 1 week before, you get a credit minus a $25 registration and materials fee; the credit is valid for one year. After that, there are no refunds or credits, and missed classes are not refunded.
special_needs_notes: Students with learning or social challenges are welcome. The center recommends talking with a staff member about your child's needs beforehand.

warnings: The source covers the 2026 season (June 22 - August 21, 2026), which is already over as of today (2026-10-13). No 2027 dates or prices are given.
Session prices are non-member tuition only. Each class also has a separate materials fee of $10-$28, paid with tuition. Family members get 10% off (e.g. $202.50 instead of $225).
Week 2 (June 29 - July 2) is 4 days and costs less ($180). Bridge care is $32 that week instead of $40.

The PDF text layout makes some week assignments unclear. The page-6 classes (Creative Comics, Wheel Throwing D, Mini Makers C, Midsummer Night's Dream Tea Party, Native American Beading) appear before the Week 5 heading. They were assigned to Week 5. The page-8 classes (Drawing as a Brain Skill, Beachy Sculpture, Creative Comics, Character Creation) were assigned to Week 7. This is based on the session lettering and on instructor schedules not overlapping. Please verify with the camp.
These are separate half-day classes, not one full-day camp. A full day means combining a morning class, an afternoon class and bridge care.
One afternoon class (Afternoon Art Adventure) and two Mini Makers sessions (B and E) list no instructor.
